value.rationale: This is the exact intrinsic maximum-volume ellipsoid and complete positive contact design of an infinite natural family of perfect-matching polytopes with arbitrary structural zeros, not merely a scalar inradius already covered by prior work. The tight-frame/electrical-resistance correspondence supplies structural insight and yields explicit sparse crown/cube families. The theorem rules out every nonspherical competitor and is mathematically stronger than classical Birkhoff inradius calculations.
